Jonas — good capture of the focus areas. A few alignment points from the bar-raiser lens:

Leveling note (Lead / IC4 vs Staff):
- Lead / IC4 (what you called Lead) = owns a cross-team initiative, defines tech requirements, mentors multiple engineers, but does not own org strategy. We should expect concrete impact measurements at the system level (product metrics + infra metrics).
- Staff / IC5 = broader strategic influence (owning cross-org roadmaps) and consistent forward-looking architecture across multiple products.

For this role, I agree we should screen at IC4 target. If Samir demonstrates consistent cross-team leadership + systems perf wins in the interviews, we can consider an uplift.

Bar-raiser interview focus (rubric pointers):
- Ownership & scope: ask for an example where they moved a perf metric with tradeoffs documented (include numbers: p95 -> p95 reduction, throughput delta).
- System design (60–80 min deep dive): evaluate reasoning on caching boundaries, KV/TTL choices, how to handle cold starts and KV cache invalidation across regions.
- Debugging exercise (30 min): present a real-world perf regression snapshot and ask for a triage plan; look for timeline, hypotheses, and measurement plan.
- Collaboration & leadership: probe on mentoring and conflict resolution — how they influence without authority.

I'll attach an updated rubric (frontend-lead-rubric-v2.docx) with specific example prompts and pass/fail signals. Please review and give edits by EOD Mon so Marissa can schedule.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Engineering — Web & Client Platform
